reference.question: What are the names of the countries with no car makers?
reference.gold_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.countryId = T2.Country
